warning.titlePre: Mercedes CLS 350d Swirl Flap & Injector Wear
paragraphs: If your CLS 350d has the OM642 diesel V6 — that's every CLS 350d across both C218 and C257 generations — swirl flap and injector wear is a well-documented pattern on this engine, backed by multiple manufacturer technical service bulletins. We replace worn swirl flaps, injector seals and the timing chain as standard on every OM642 rebuild.
